title: Tourist list — out of contact in Bhotekoshi (Department of Tourism)
citation: Department of Tourism — tourist list (Bhote Koshi flood)
body: Official Department of Tourism page listing foreign nationals reported out of contact, missing, rescued, or contacted following the Bhote Koshi flood. Pointed to by NDRRMA on 1 September 2026. Search on the original site — we do not republish names.
